decisions.reason: The firm has publicly committed to this product with a dedicated page and invested in a multi-model line, so escalation pressures to justify that commitment make a near-term drop unlikely.
Similar public commitment and sunk costs in the product line lead management to persist even if results are mixed.
Only a website mention indicates lower visible commitment, but prior investment and possible temporary market disruptions keep management from dropping it yet.
As a custom hearing protection line serving hearing-care retailers, it is central to the firm's announced custom-device strategy, so management continues despite moderate public commitment.
